settings.hero_body: That satisfying feeling when the last piece belongs. Eight colors and eight companions, ready to turn the space you have saved into a complete little collection.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_body: Bring all eight home and give that waiting space its complete cast.
settings.moods_body: Every design pictured is included, from the first lavender ears to the last charcoal hood.
settings.personality_title: A place for each. A collection together.
settings.personality_body: Build a tidy row or a balanced pair of rows. The pleasure is seeing every color find its place; shelves and display props are yours to choose.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
